sloka: पृच्छन्तमसकृत्तं वै भार्गवं दीप्ततेजसम् ।देवयानी तु सङ्क्रुद्धा पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.५८.१८ ॥
transliteration: pṛcchantamasakṛttaṁ vai bhārgavaṁ dīptatejasam ।devayānī tu saṅkruddhā pitaraṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 7.58.18 ॥

translations.english: To that Bhargava of blazing splendor, who was repeatedly asking her, Devayani, greatly enraged, indeed spoke these words to her father.
